what: Mac-side Orin Nano SD images, flashing app and offline arm runtime are ready
why: The large downloads and compatible Python packages are cached so microSD flashing and first-boot setup can start when the hardware is connected.
details: Both official NVIDIA SD ZIPs match expected lengths and pass complete ZIP CRC checks; local SHA256 values recorded (no NVIDIA-published ZIP digest found). Etcher 2.1.9 passed publisher hash, disk-image, signature and notarization checks and is installed/open. Cached Linux ARM64 Python 3.12.15/uv, pinned SDK source, 17 runtime/build wheels, and a verified project Git bundle. 140 offline arm tests passed on macOS. No SD/SSD writes, firmware changes or robot commands. Jetson first boot, OS APT downloads, SSH and hardware verification remain pending.
